entries.german: A: Konrad von Rosenberg, Viztum zu Amberg. E: Abt Friedrich von Kloster Ensdorf. Gerichtsbrief in der Klage des Klosters Ensdorf gegen Friedrich und Hartnid die Theuerner zu Theuern wegen 2 Holzstätten bei Theuern, genannt die Sunnleiten und die Mad.
entries.english: Konrad von Rosenberg, Vizedom zu Amberg, issued a court record in Ensdorf Monastery's lawsuit against Friedrich and Hartnid die Theuerner of Theuern concerning two woodlots near Theuern, called the Sunnleiten and the Mad.

facts.content: issued a court record in Ensdorf Abbey’s lawsuit against Friedrich and Hartnid die Theuerner concerning woodlots near Theuern.

entries.source: Monumenta Boica 24, Num. CIII, Testimonium iudiciale
entries.german:
Ich Conrad von Rosenberger Vitztum ze Amberg bechenn of-
fenbar mit dem brief. daz Abbt Fridreich von Enstorf vor mir
vf der Lantschran ze Amberg. hat an behabt. fridreich vnd
Hertneyd den Tewnern von Tewrn mit volg. mit vrag mit
vrtail. vnd mit dem rehten. als reht ist di zwo Holtzstet genant
di Sunleyteh vnd di Mad bey Tewrn gelegen. also daz di
selben Tewrn di vorgenant Holtzstet Hayen sullen. vnd wenn
man daz holtz verchawft, So sullen si dar vmb den dritten pfe-
ning nemen von dem gelt vnd di zwen Pfening antwurten dem
Abbt. vnd dem Gotzhaws ze Enstorf. vnd sol auch der Abbt
vnd sein Gotzhaws der vorgenant Holtzstet, bey nutz vnd ge-
wer sitzen als vorgeschriben stet. vnd von nutz vnd gewir ant-
wurten. wer dar vf iht ze sprechen hat. als reht ist. vnd dar
zu sol ich in oder wer meins Herren obersten Ambtman ist
schützen vnd schermen als der Lantschran reht ist. dez ward
im von gerihtz wegen ain brief ertailt mit dez Lantgerichtz In-
sigel daz dar an hangt. Der geben ist an Montag nach sand
Gallen tag do man zalt von Christes geburt. drewtzehn hun-
dert Jar. vnd dar nach in dem Sibentzigsten Jar.
entries.english: I, Konrad von Rosenberg[er?], Vitztum at Amberg, declare publicly with this letter that Abbot Friedrich of Ensdorf has proved before me at the Landschranne at Amberg, against Friedrich and Hertneyd the Tewner of Tewrn, with pursuit, with inquiry, with judgment and with the law, as is right, the two wood-sites called the Sunleyteh and the Mad, situated near Tewrn; so that the same Tewrn shall fence in the aforesaid wood-sites, and when the wood is sold, they shall take the third pfennig of the money for it and hand over the two pfennigs to the abbot and the monastery at Ensdorf. The abbot and his monastery shall hold the aforesaid wood-sites in use and possession as stated above, and shall answer for use and possession to whoever has any claim on them, as is right. And in addition I, or whoever is my lord's highest official, shall protect and defend them, as is right at the Landschranne. For this a letter was issued to him by the court, with the seal of the Landgericht, which hangs on it. Given on the Monday after St. Gall's day, when one counted from Christ's birth thirteen hundred years and after that in the seventieth year.

facts.content: issued the letter at the Landschranne at Amberg confirming Abbot Friedrich of Ensdorf's claim to two wood-sites near Tewrn.
promised to protect and defend Ensdorf Monastery in its possession of the wood-sites, as the Landschranne rules.
proved before the Landschranne at Amberg his monastery's right to two wood-sites near Tewrn against Friedrich and Hertneyd the Tewner.
was the opponent of the Abbot of Ensdorf at the Landschranne at Amberg and has to fence the two wood-sites.
